notes.title: Full Game Release Now On Steam + Update live!
notes.content:
[h3]
Finally the wait is over ... I just wanted to update you that THE FULL VERSION OF THE GAME IS NOW RELEASED  TO STEAM! Are you ready? [/h3]

Step into the tiny shoes of a baby, trapped in a spine-chilling child care facility where nothing is what it seems. Armed with only your wits—and your trusty tricycle—navigate dark hallways, escape horrifying monsters, and survive the night!

Playing as a baby on a tricycle might seem playful at first, but as you venture deeper into the open-world childcare center, the nightmares begin to unfold. Are you brave enough to face your nightmares head on?

Also, regarding the Prologue - it has been updated with the latest changes to align with the release.
[list]
[*] Fixed a couple of bug issues with the game.
[*] Saving and loading issue now been fixed.
[*] Help notes have been updated.
[*] Updated some sounds and audio.
[/list]

[b]Get the full version of the game on steam here: [/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2836820/Baby_Blues_Nightmares__Toddler_Horror_Game

I just want to say to everyone who has followed this journey I can’t thank you enough. I hope Baby Blues Nightmares brings you the chilling, immersive experience that I envisioned! Have fun.

notes.title: Baby Blues Nightmares - Updated Prologue V2
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Hope you are well. Currently updated the Prologue of the game with some bug fixes, AI updates and general improvements. 

[list]
[*] Fixed the sound slider to adjust the sound of the game.
[*] Added some tool tips to let you know what you need to do next.
[*] Added a couple of new help notes.
[*] Updated the game to align with the updates made for the full version.
[*] Ceiling bug issue have been fixed (Sorry speed runners)
[*] Some collider issues have been fixed.
[*] Updated some sounds and audio.
[*] Added some more items that can be found around.
[/list]

Don't forget to wishlist the full game on steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2836820/Baby_Blues_Nightmares__Toddler_Horror_Game - it's releasing soon!

Also feel free to join in our small community over on discord: https://discord.com/invite/d8WUuuRCJK - I will be more then happy to have a chat with you if you have any question there :) 

Thank you very much and hope you all have a great day!
